name: note/UX-B-15
text: UX-B-15 — ONE page-actions menu, used by both surfaces. The panel's PageContextMenu is the implementation and this bar composes it, so three drifts cannot recur: Delete is disabled-with-a-reason at one page here as it is in the panel (today the bar HIDES it, PageTabBar.tsx:406, while PageContextMenu.tsx:99-106 disables it with a tooltip); 'Set as home' runs the same external-page guard and raises the same navigation warning (today PageTabBar.tsx:207-210 skips both, which usePages.ts:294-324 does); and one delete confirmation wording, not the two at PageTabBar.tsx:424 and PagesTab.tsx:329.
_style_source: Every new node is a CLONE of a sibling whose style is already right, per edit-board-nodes.mjs's own rule.

Read the board and re-place before --apply, or these three land on top of the drawing.

name: note/UX-B-09
text: UX-B-09 — the rename popover writes the URL it displays. It computes normalizeSlug(editName) and renders /{slug} (PageTabBar.tsx:64-74, :328-332), then submits updatePage(id, { name }) alone (:139-145): type 'Pricing', read '/pricing', keep /page-3. Either write it — for any page whose slug was never hand-edited, which the engine tracks as slugManuallySet (PageManager.ts:145) — or stop drawing it.

name: note/UX-B-28
text: UX-B-28 — switching pages clears the canvas selection, so the inspector is empty rather than editing something off-screen. Nothing clears it today: PageManager.ts:222-236 emits page:activated and PAGE_CHANGED, :254-278 removes a deleted page's descendants from the registry, and SelectionManager.clear() (:103) is called by neither — so edits made in the right-hand panel land on an element that is no longer on screen.
